_doc: Upgrade cards (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md section 8), drawn by UpgradePool. power: true marks a card that raises an attack skill's damage output (a new attack skill, its rank, more shots/targets, damage, cooldown); pity.draws = N: after N draws in a row without a power card the next draw starts with one (0 = off). kind: skill_new (learn `skill` at the tier starting rank), skill_rank (tier canonical-level gain of `skill`), skill_mod (modifies `skill`), passive / stat (player modifiers), potion_tier (changes potion_kind to item_id, preserves stock). requires (all optional): jobs (the player's current job equals one of these), skills (owned skill keys), min_rank ({skill: rank}), min_level, potions ({kind: current item ID}). skill_rank and skill_mod cards also require owning `skill`; skill_new requires not owning it and a free slot of the skill's kind. max_rank 0 = unlimited; skill_rank cards use the canonical skill cap, with the owned skill level also gating offers (a Normal learn starts at level 1, so N-1 Normal rank-card picks reach N). effects: {stat, op, value} applied once per rank taken; op add sums, op mul multiplies (compounds per rank), Potion tier cards have no stat effects. fallback is a separate filler card, excluded from weighted draws and offered once when fewer than 3 cards remain; its heal effects restore a fraction of the relevant maximum. Skill stats: count, cooldown, pierce, speed, range, damage (multiplier), crit (chance, additive). Player stat cards: magnet (radius); removed Max HP, flat Max MP and flat speed cards are replaced by owned skills. rarity: seeded Potential tier weights and Fortune scaling. magnitudes: per-kind tier tables (stacking covers skill_mod/stat/passive), overridden per tier by each card magnitudes table; max spends remaining headroom. desc: {magnitude} is the actual rank/step/starting-rank gain; {value} scales additive values or displays a compounded multiplicative percentage (two decimal places). Canonical skill caps and WZ skill prerequisites are tier A; card weights, modifiers and offer rules are tier C (ours). Icons are WZ paths, all imported by the asset manifest: potion tiers use Item.wz/Consume 2000001/2000002/2000006 (items[]), skill cards use their own canonical Skill.wz icon, and Magnet the Meso Magnet pet equip 1812000 (Character.wz/PetEquip).

rarity._tier: Tier C: survivor card odds; non-Normal weights multiply by 1 + max(0, Fortune) * fortune_scale, then all weights normalize.

magnitudes._tier: Tier C: rank increments, modifier steps and new-skill starting ranks; max spends all remaining headroom.
